第74章 绿帽子带好了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“支书，我什么时候成你们家的儿媳妇了？什么时候搔首弄姿了？”

“你怎么随意造谣诬陷别人的清白？”

王春晓眼眶顿时红润了起来，在这个年代，被造谣这种不洁的事情，影响可是很大的，不仅仅影响女孩，就连女孩一家子都要被人戳脊梁骨的。

“我造谣？诬陷？你刚刚在干什么？不就是在别的男人面前搔首弄姿？你爹妈没教你男女授受不亲吗？”

“不知廉耻！”

赵支书见王春晓竟然还敢反驳自己，心中怒火升了起来，都被自己抓到现行了，竟还敢反驳？

今天，真是丢人丢到家了啊！！

绿帽子，这可是绿帽子啊，全村人都看到了。

赵支书现在恨不得冲上去将李青山这小子给撕碎，但是支书身份的他，还是硬生生忍住了。

不能乱，不能乱了方寸。

要稳住！！

“老瘪犊子，你说什么玩意呢？”

李青山顿时不开心了，一把将王春晓拉到身后保护起来，双目凶恶的盯着赵支书道：“王春晓什么时候和你家儿子结婚了，什么时候扯证了？”

“回答我！”

最后一声，李青山是运转体内纯阳真气怒吼出来的，中气十足，宛若虎啸，双目更是凶狠无比。

站在赵支书身后的石溪村百姓，只觉得浑身一震，一股寒意从头到脚席卷而来，只觉得头皮发麻，看向李青山的时候不知道为什么，竟然带着一丝退缩。

李青山这小子，怎么这么凶？

“就算没扯证，那也是早晚的事情，我们两家都说好了，容不得别人说一个不字。”赵支书开口反驳道。

“王春晓没答应，你个老瘪犊子和王春晓老爹就商量好了，强逼着春晓答应，你们这是在干什么？包办婚姻吗？”

“迫害妇女吗？”

“赵支书，你今天说的一切，周围村民可都听在耳朵里了，这件事情，我要是捅到了土乡妇女主任那里，捅到了乡政府那里，你这个支书，就别干了。”

李青山语气中带着威胁道。

包办婚姻，迫害妇女？

赵支书顿时背后发凉，一股冷汗冒了出来。

这帽子可大了。

这种事情，乡里面几次开会也说过，作为支书的自己也是知道的，大家平日里就当作潜规则，水面下的事情，也无所谓，不会有什么影响。

但要是真的捅破了，那就可大可小了。

最重要的是，自己这个支书的身份，不能和这些土包子一样无所谓，包办婚姻最多被教训一顿。

这要是被树立了典型，就麻烦了。

这小子，怎么懂得这么多？

“李青山，你不要胡诌，我家儿子给春晓买了一件成品衣，可是五块钱，她穿上了，不就是代表接受我家儿子了吗？”

“既然接受我家儿子了，那说是我们家儿媳妇，有错吗？”

“就算现在不是，那说一声准儿媳妇，有错吗？”

“未婚妻，对，用城里人的话说，就是未婚妻。”

赵支书突然想了起来，开口道。

“呵呵！”

“你儿子买的？”

“你家买得起吗？”

李青山轻笑一声，脸上满是不屑道：“不瞒你说，这成品衣，五块钱，是我从供销社买来的，是我送给王春晓的。”

这话刚刚落下，现场顿时哄闹起来。

一个个都宛若吃了大瓜一样，这可真是石溪村今年最大的瓜了，村长家这是头上泛绿光啊！

“李青山，你个小瘪犊子，你勾搭我家准儿媳妇是不是？”赵支书指着李青山，只觉得体内一阵气血上涌道。

这小子想干什么，哪个女人能扛得住这种糖衣炮弹？

“老瘪犊子，你别给我胡说！”

“每一句话都在污蔑我和春晓的清白，我告诉你，我送春晓这衣服，是因为春晓要帮我介绍媳妇。”

“还有，什么勾搭你儿媳妇，你哪来的儿媳妇？”

李青山声音严肃道。

“就是，我要给青山哥介绍媳妇，他才送我的，怎么就是勾搭了，你不要乱说。”

王春晓虽然想承认李青山在乎自己，才会送自己裙子，但也知道人言可畏，自己一个还未嫁人的姑娘，可不能和一个单身汉这么胡来，就算是以后结婚了，也难免落人口舌，便顺着李青山的意思奶凶奶凶的说了下去。

“娘的，当老子傻子啊？”

赵支书都想要骂娘了，要是因为这个原因送的，刚刚用得着在李青山面前搔首弄姿，而且看李青山的那种眼神，错不了……！

根本错不了！

当初自己喜欢的女人看别人的时候，也是这个眼神。

这下好了，全村人都知道了。

我老赵家，绿了啊！！

“少他娘的废话，你今天污蔑我和春晓的清白，就是不对，当众给我和春晓道歉，再把我家另外两块宅基地给批了，这件事情就算完！”

“否则，我就告到乡政府！”

李青山开口道。

现在的宅基地虽然没什么要求，但也需要一点流程的，就是村委提交给乡政府，乡政府也不会卡着，一般直接就给办了，关键是需要村委，也就是支书提交。

赵支书被自己得罪死了，肯定不会愿意办的。

虽然自己也有办法，但未免太耽搁事情了。

刚好，趁着今天的事情，一起把自己嫂子和老爹户口下面的宅基地都给批了。

现在关于宅基地的标准十分的宽松。

趁着现在赶紧将砖瓦房起了，否则未来影响就不太好了。

“李青山！”

“山高路远，咱们走着瞧！”

赵支书望着李青山，牙齿都快要咬碎的了，但是当了这些年的村长和支书，这些定力和稳重还是有的，语气平静，又恢复了往日的威严道：“今天是我说错话了，春晓，你别放在心上。”

“行了，别废话了，去办宅基地的事情！”

“办完了，我还得回去忙活呢！”

"Party secretary, when did I become your daughter-in-law? When did I start showing off?"

"Why do you want to spread rumors and accuse others of their innocence?"

Wang Chunxiao's eyes suddenly turned red. In this era, such unclean things as spreading rumors have a great impact. It not only affects the girl, but also the girl's family will have their spines stabbed.

"Did I spread rumors? Make false accusations? What were you doing just now? Wasn't it just showing off in front of other men? Didn't your parents teach you whether men and women can have sex or not?"

"Shameless!"

When Party Secretary Zhao saw that Wang Chunxiao still dared to refute him, his anger rose in his heart. He had already been caught doing it, so he still dared to refute him?

Today, I am so embarrassed!!

Cuckold, this is a cuckold, the whole village saw it.

Party Secretary Zhao wanted to rush forward and tear Li Qingshan to pieces, but as Party Secretary, he still held back.

It can't be messy, it can't be messed up.

Be steady!!

"Old brat, what are you talking about?"

Li Qingshan suddenly became unhappy and pulled Wang Chunxiao behind him to protect him. He stared at Party Secretary Zhao with fierce eyes and said, "When did Wang Chunxiao marry your son, and when did he pull the certificate?"

"Answer me!"

The last sound was roared out by Li Qingshan as he circulated the pure yang energy in his body. It was full of energy, like a tiger roaring, and his eyes were extremely fierce.

The people of Shixi Village standing behind Secretary Zhao felt a shock all over, a chill swept from head to toe, and their scalp was numb. When they looked at Li Qingshan, they didn't know why, but they flinched a little.

Why is this guy Li Qingshan so cruel?

"Even if there is no evidence, it will only happen sooner or later. Our two families have made an agreement and cannot tolerate others saying no." Secretary Zhao retorted.

"Wang Chunxiao didn't agree, so you old fool and Wang Chunxiao's father discussed it and forced Chunxiao to agree. What are you doing? Arranged marriage?"

"Persecution of women?"

"Party Secretary Zhao, everything you said today has been heard by the surrounding villagers. If I bring this matter to the Tuxiang Women's Director or the township government, you, the Party Secretary, should stop doing it."

Li Qingshan said with a threatening tone.

Arranged marriages and persecution of women?

Secretary Zhao suddenly felt a chill in his back and broke out in a cold sweat.

This hat is huge.

This kind of thing has been mentioned in several meetings in the township, and as a party secretary, I also know it. Everyone treats it as an unspoken rule on weekdays. Things under the water don't matter and will not have any impact.

But if it is really revealed, it will be a big deal.

The most important thing is that my status as a party secretary cannot be as indifferent as these bumpkins. The most I can do is get a lesson for an arranged marriage.

It would be troublesome if this was set as a typical example.

How does this kid know so much?

"Li Qingshan, don't make nonsense. My son bought Chunxiao a ready-made coat, but it costs five yuan. If she wears it, doesn't it mean that she accepts my son?"

"Since you have accepted my son, is it wrong to say that he is our daughter-in-law?"

"Even if it's not the case now, is it wrong to say that you are your future daughter-in-law?"

"Fiancée, yes, as the city people say, it is fiancée."

Secretary Zhao suddenly remembered and said.

"Haha!"

"Did your son buy it?"

"Can your family afford it?"

Li Qingshan chuckled lightly and said with disdain on his face: "To tell you the truth, I bought these finished clothes for five yuan from the supply and marketing cooperative and gave them to Wang Chunxiao."

As soon as he said these words, the scene suddenly became noisy.

Everyone felt like they had eaten a big melon. This was really the biggest melon in Shixi Village this year. The head of the village chief’s house was glowing green!

"Li Qingshan, you little brat, are you hooking up with my daughter-in-law-to-be?" Secretary Zhao pointed at Li Qingshan and felt a surge of energy and blood in his body.

What does this guy want to do? Which woman can withstand such sugar-coated bombs?

"Old bastard, don't talk nonsense to me!"

"Every word is slandering Chunxiao and I's innocence. Let me tell you, I gave Chunxiao these clothes because Chunxiao wanted to help me introduce my wife."

"Also, why did you seduce your daughter-in-law? Where did you get your daughter-in-law?"

Li Qingshan said in a serious voice.

"That's right, I want to introduce a wife to Brother Qingshan, so he gave it to me. Why is it just a hookup? Don't talk nonsense."

Although Wang Chunxiao wanted to admit that Li Qingshan cared about him, so he gave her the dress, but he also knew that people's words can be scary. As an unmarried girl, she couldn't act like this with a single man. Even if she got married in the future, it would be hard to avoid being talked about, so she followed Li Qingshan's intention and continued speaking fiercely.

"Mom, do you think I'm a fool?"

Secretary Zhao almost wanted to scold him. If he gave it to him for this reason, he would have just used it to show off in front of Li Qingshan, and the look in Li Qingshan's eyes was unmistakable...!

You can’t go wrong at all!

The woman he liked at the beginning also looked like this when he looked at others.

Now, everyone in the village knows.

My old Zhao family is green!!

"Stop talking nonsense, you are wrong today in slandering Chunxiao and I's innocence. Apologize to me and Chunxiao in public, and then approve the other two pieces of homestead for my family, and this matter will be over!"

"Otherwise, I will file a lawsuit with the township government!"

Li Qingshan said.

Although there are no requirements for homesteads now, it still requires a bit of process. Even if the village committee submits it to the township government, the township government will not be stuck and usually handle it directly. The key is that it needs to be submitted by the village committee, that is, the party secretary.

Secretary Zhao was so offended by him that he would definitely not be willing to do it.

Although I have my own ideas, it would delay things too much.

It just so happened that, taking advantage of today's events, we approved the homesteads under the household registrations of my sister-in-law and my father.

Nowadays, the standards for homesteads are very loose.

Build brick and tile houses now, otherwise the impact will not be good in the future.

"Li Qingshan!"

"The mountains are high and the road is far, let's wait and see!"

Party Secretary Zhao looked at Li Qingshan, his teeth were about to break, but after being the village chief and Party Secretary for these years, he still had the determination and stability. His tone was calm, and he regained his previous dignity and said: "I said the wrong thing today, Chunxiao, don't take it to heart."

"Okay, stop talking nonsense and go handle the homestead matters!"

"It's done, I still have to go back to work!"
